Application Data.NAME: Telecom Solutions Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Telecom Solutions Inc. provides comprehensive answering and telemarketing services to a diverse range of clients, focusing on customer engagement, lead generation, and appointment scheduling. Our operations include inbound and outbound call handling, client consultations, and data management, all supported by a dedicated team trained in compliance with the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) and other relevant regulations. We prioritize data security with robust IT safeguards, including firewalls and encrypted storage, ensuring the protection of sensitive customer information. Our team is committed to maintaining high service quality through regular monitoring and training programs.
